node_01_threshold.title: The Threshold of Seven Doors
node_01_threshold.description: You arrive via Earth's secret wayline — a small, dark chamber with seven doorways. Each door is unique, keyed to a Prime World's wayline. Beyond them: the seven thrones, the deadlocked Council, and the empty seat that decides everything.

node_02_doors.title: The Seven Doors
node_02_doors.description: Read the doors — a Key's lock-check. Each is attuned to a Prime's wayline: Aradia's forest arch, Bazaroth's obsidian mouth, Enid's storm gate, Cathedral's stargate, Ikaris' harp-door, Imago's server-port. Touch the right one and wish, and the chamber admits you.

node_03_council.title: The Deadlocked Council
node_03_council.description: Six gatekeepers, six thrones, and a gridlock that has lasted centuries. The Master Harper speaks for Ikaris; the Infernal King's envoy schemes for Bazaroth; Lyra Vance carries Enid's pressure. Break the deadlock — politically, not with a blade.

node_04_empty_throne.title: The Empty Throne
node_04_empty_throne.description: Earth's throne sits empty — Ozymandius's seat, the deciding vote, missing for centuries. The whole game is here: without the Earth gatekeeper, the Council can't act. And the party must decide who — or what — takes it.

node_05_rogue_seat.title: The Rogue Seat
node_05_rogue_seat.description: Bazaroth's envoy forces the vote — hellspawn enforcers materialize from the door, and the deadlock turns violent. Hold the rogue seat, or the Infernal King's scheme wins by default.

node_06_weaver_relic.title: The Weaver Relic
node_06_weaver_relic.description: The rogue seat is held, the deadlock is broken. In the chamber's centre rests a Weaver relic — an artefact of power that exerts control over the Cosmic Web. And a seat that finally has a choice to make.
